metadata.description: Causal analysis without the guesswork: a step-by-step way to answer 'did X cause Y?' from your data, plus synthetic datasets with known answers to test it.

plugins.name: causal-analyst
plugins.description: Two skills: causal-analyst (asks the questions a good analyst would ask, builds the model, and grades the answer from A to D) and causal-data-generator (realistic practice and test datasets with a sealed answer key).
